description.value: When the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} drops to 0 Hit Points, it dies only if it is within 30 feet of its anathema (a thing the DM chooses as the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s most hated thing). Otherwise, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} drops to 1 Hit Point and teleports to a harmless demiplane, and it can't return to the plane it left for 2d6 days. When the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} teleports away, each creature within 60 feet of the space it left is cursed. Until the curse ends, a creature has Disadvantage on ability checks and saving throws, and the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} knows its location anywhere in the multiverse.
